add_subdirectory(runtime)
foreach(runtime_target IN ITEMS antlr4_static antlr4_shared)
    if(TARGET ${runtime_target})
        target_include_directories(${runtime_target} PUBLIC
                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/runtime/src)
    endif()
endforeach()
set(ANTLR4_COMPILER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/antlr4-compiler.jar CACHE INTERNAL "")

function(antlr4_gen def_path target_path)
    find_program(JAVA java REQUIRED)
    message("-- Java Path: ${JAVA}")
    message("-- Antlr4 Compiler Path: ${ANTLR4_COMPILER}")
    file(GLOB G4_DEFS ${def_path}/*.g4)
    foreach (g4_file ${G4_DEFS})
        get_filename_component(g4_name ${g4_file} NAME_WE)
        execute_process(COMMAND ${JAVA} -jar ${ANTLR4_COMPILER} -Dlanguage=Cpp -visitor -no-listener -o ${target_path} ${g4_file}
                RESULT_VARIABLE g4_gen_result
                ERROR_VARIABLE g4_gen_error)
        if(NOT "${g4_gen_result}" STREQUAL "0")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Antlr4 generation failed for ${g4_file}: ${g4_gen_result}\n${g4_gen_error}")
        endif()
        foreach(g4_suffix IN ITEMS Lexer.h Lexer.cpp Parser.h Parser.cpp Visitor.h Visitor.cpp BaseVisitor.h BaseVisitor.cpp)
            if(NOT EXISTS "${target_path}/${g4_name}${g4_suffix}")
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Antlr4 generation did not produce ${target_path}/${g4_name}${g4_suffix}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        message("-- Antlr4 gen success: ${g4_file}")
    endforeach ()
endfunction()
